title: Recording the Jones and Collins sides and naming the tunes
summary: Where the records were made and how band members chose titles such as Tip Easy Blues, Damp Weather and Astoria Strut.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Oh, he. Where did you make those records? Huh? Where did you make those records with, uh, with Jones and Collins?
Oh, I know, that's on the street on the Tain Hall. You know what Tain Hall? Yeah. Well, that's where I made it. I don't know, maybe.
Yeah. But where did you get the names for those numbers? Huh? Where did you get the names for those numbers?
Well, the different fellas pick out the names. You know, they get the names. David Jones, Joe Ruscio, Manny Sills, all of them, they get different names.
What does Tip Easy mean? Huh? What does Tip Easy mean when you call it the Tip Easy Blues?
I don't know what the hell it means, man. I don't know how I played it.
You played like L on that one.
Yeah, I don't know what it means. I don't know what it means, though. Yeah.
And they got one called Damp Weather.
And one called Astoria Strut. Yeah. And one called Duet Stone. Yeah.
